########################################
#
# Script contains the clone overlap between matching ONT (S1_ONT_Q17) and
# PacBio (S1_PB_Q17) datasets.
#
# Joint clone annotation into scatter figure shown in Fig. S4
#
########################################

Joint IGH clone assignment and molecular-group abundance comparison for the
ONT and PacBio technical replicates.

```{r settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(scoper)

ONT_BCR_AIRR_PATH <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_ont_sd17_af5/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv"
PACBIO_BCR_AIRR_PATH <- "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_pb/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv"

MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT <- 2L
CLONE_THRESHOLD <- 0.15
NPROC <- 8
OUTPUT_DIR <- "ont_pacbio_clone_comparison"

IGH_CONSTANT_GENES <- c("IGHA1", "IGHA2", "IGHG1", "IGHG2", "IGHG3", "IGHG4", "IGHM")
CLONE_COLORS <- c("Shared" = "#4C78A8", "ONT only" = "#F58518", "PacBio only" = "#54A24B")
```

Read productive IGH sequences and apply the same downstream QC to both datasets.
Both platforms use the UMI–SPBC group identifier as the molecular identifier.

```{r read-and-filter}
read_igh <- function(path, dataset_name) {
  read_tsv(path.expand(path), show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    select(-any_of(c("x", "y"))) %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_name,
           molecule_id = group,
           sequence_id = paste(dataset_name, sequence_id, sep = "|"),
           consensus_count = as.integer(consensus_count), junction_length = as.integer(junction_length),
           umi = toupper(umi), junction = toupper(junction),
           c_call_subfam = str_remove(c_call, "\\*.*$"),
           v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence),
             start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
    filter(locus == "IGH", toupper(productive) %in% c("T", "TRUE", "1"),
           !is.na(molecule_id), molecule_id != "",
           !is.na(c_call), str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus,
           c_call_subfam %in% IGH_CONSTANT_GENES,
           !is.na(umi), umi != "", !str_detect(umi, "TTTTTTTTTTT"),
           !is.na(junction), junction != "", !str_detect(junction, "N"),
           !is.na(v_region_sequence), v_region_sequence != "", !str_detect(v_region_sequence, "N"),
           consensus_count >= MIN_CONSENSUS_COUNT)
}

ont_igh <- read_igh(ONT_BCR_AIRR_PATH, "ONT")
pacbio_igh <- read_igh(PACBIO_BCR_AIRR_PATH, "PacBio")

igh_combined <- bind_rows(ont_igh, pacbio_igh) %>%
  arrange(v_call, j_call, junction_length, junction, dataset, molecule_id)
```

Assign clones jointly by length-normalized junction nucleotide distance within
compatible V/J-gene and junction-length groups. threshold 0.15

```{r joint-clones}
igh_joint_clones <- scoper::hierarchicalClones(igh_combined,
  method = "nt", linkage = "single", normalize = "len", first = FALSE,
  threshold = CLONE_THRESHOLD, verbose = FALSE, nproc = NPROC) %>%
  mutate(clone_id_joint = as.character(clone_id))
```

Count distinct molecular groups separately within each dataset and clone. The
comparison includes all retained groups

```{r clone-counts}
clone_counts <- igh_joint_clones %>%
  distinct(dataset, clone_id_joint, molecule_id) %>%
  count(dataset, clone_id_joint, name = "n_molecules") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = n_molecules,
              values_fill = 0, names_prefix = "n_molecules_") %>%
  mutate(shared_clone = n_molecules_ONT > 0 & n_molecules_PacBio > 0,
         clone_status = case_when(shared_clone ~ "Shared",
                                  n_molecules_ONT > 0 ~ "ONT only",
                                  TRUE ~ "PacBio only"),
         clone_status = factor(clone_status, levels = names(CLONE_COLORS)),
         total_molecules = n_molecules_ONT + n_molecules_PacBio) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_molecules), clone_id_joint)

clone_overlap_summary <- clone_counts %>%
  summarise(n_ont_clones = sum(n_molecules_ONT > 0),
            n_pacbio_clones = sum(n_molecules_PacBio > 0),
            n_shared_clones = sum(shared_clone), n_union_clones = n()) %>%
  mutate(fraction_ont_clones_shared = n_shared_clones / n_ont_clones,
         fraction_pacbio_clones_shared = n_shared_clones / n_pacbio_clones,
         jaccard_overlap = n_shared_clones / n_union_clones)

shared_molecule_summary <- clone_counts %>%
  select(shared_clone, n_molecules_ONT, n_molecules_PacBio) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("n_molecules_"), names_to = "dataset",
               names_prefix = "n_molecules_", values_to = "n_molecules") %>%
  group_by(dataset) %>%
  summarise(molecules_in_shared_clones = sum(n_molecules[shared_clone]),
            n_molecules = sum(n_molecules), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(fraction_molecules_in_shared_clones = molecules_in_shared_clones / n_molecules)

clone_overlap_summary
shared_molecule_summary
```

Each point represents a joint clone. Point area encodes the sum of molecular
counts across the two datasets; a group detected on both platforms contributes
once to each dataset's count

```{r scatter, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
axis_counts <- c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000)
axis_limits <- c(1, max(clone_counts$n_molecules_ONT, clone_counts$n_molecules_PacBio) + 1)

p_ont_pacbio_clone_abundance <- ggplot(clone_counts,
  aes(x = n_molecules_ONT + 1, y = n_molecules_PacBio + 1)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = clone_status, size = total_molecules),
             shape = 21, color = "grey20", stroke = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = axis_counts + 1, labels = scales::comma(axis_counts), limits = axis_limits) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = axis_counts + 1, labels = scales::comma(axis_counts), limits = axis_limits) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CLONE_COLORS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 7) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  labs(x = "ONT IGH molecules per clone", y = "PacBio IGH molecules per clone",
       fill = "Clone overlap", size = "Combined\nmolecules") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(order = 1), fill = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5), legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 0),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.5}
p_ont_pacbio_clone_abundance
```
